text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Kris S won the Japanese Derby, 
brilliantly shattering the "Aoba Sho 
jinx." But refusing to treat this as the 
finish line, she fixed her gaze on what 
lay ahead.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The crowd expressed annoyance at her faint 
reaction. Zenno Rob Roy, on the other 
hand, saw her unshakeable demeanor even in 
victory as the embodiment of the "hero" 
she ought to strive for.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite her defeat, Tanino Gimlet drove 
the crowd wild with her run. Symboli Kris 
S felt she could never ignite such sheer 
frenzy herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tanino Gimlet bids farewell, declaring the 
play has reached its end. Symboli Kris S 
is left struggling to grasp her true 
intentions.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In any case, Symboli Kris S delivered 
massive results. And in order to build 
upon those results even further, a new 
start was made.
